title: FirewallForge Backup
description: Schema for .fwbackup files created by FirewallForge. Contains Windows Firewall rule metadata and an optional netsh binary export.

BackupDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the backup was created.

ComputerName.description: Name of the computer the backup was taken from, or 'Custom Export' for editor-created backups.

RuleCount.description: Number of rules in the RuleDetails array.

NetshBackup.description: Base64-encoded binary payload from 'netsh advfirewall export'. Present only in backups created by FirewallManager (live backups), not in editor-created exports.

Name.description: Internal rule identifier (GUID or system name).

DisplayName.description: Human-readable rule name shown in the UI.

Direction.description: Traffic direction the rule applies to.

Action.description: Whether the rule allows or blocks matching traffic.

Enabled.description: Whether the rule is currently enabled.

Profile.description: Firewall profile(s) the rule applies to. Values: Any, Domain, Private, Public, or comma-separated combinations.

Protocol.description: Network protocol. Values: Any, TCP, UDP, ICMPv4, ICMPv6, or a protocol number.

LocalPort.description: Local port(s) or port range. 'Any' means all ports.

RemotePort.description: Remote port(s) or port range. 'Any' means all ports.

RemoteAddress.description: Remote address filter. IP, CIDR, or 'Any'.

Program.description: Full path to the program executable, or 'Any' for all programs.

Service.description: Windows service short name the rule is scoped to (e.g. 'dnscache'). Empty string or null means not service-scoped.

Group.description: Rule group name from Windows Firewall metadata. May be empty for custom rules.
